text:
I travel with friends a lot and we used to always use Splitwise to settle our group's expenses, but over the years I've grown so frustrated with its user experience how bad it is for entering anything more complex than an evenly split bill.

So I though I could surely do better. I mean, how hard could it be?

That was 4 years ago and it's been my pet project for quite some time. It never felt close to done, but recently - admittedly with lots of AI help - I've managed to polish it enough to call it ready. We've already used it with our group and now I'm putting it out here hoping some of you will find it useful too.

You can try it on web (no sign-up needed), or download an iOS or Android app: https://app.splitsetter.com https://apps.apple.com/us/app/splitsetter/id6822295139 https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.splitsette...

It's free to use, except for the optional AI based receipt scans (because tokens cost me money), and I plan to keep it that way.

It's local-first and event sourced, should work well offline and syncs when it can. I probably spent way too much time and effort on the sync architecture, but I really tried to make it bulletproof.

Let me know what you think.
title: Show HN: Splitsetter – my attempt at a bill splitting app
